interpretation.scope: Five completed evaluations, single shortened compliant geometry, terminal weight fixed at 0.05.
interpretation.statement: On the shortened compliant geometry at fixed terminal_tip_speed_weight=0.05, holding_max_speed is ~0.0127 m/s and passing for holding∈{0.0,0.05} but ~0.022-0.023 m/s and failing for holding∈{0.075,0.09,0.10}, with a non-monotone jump concentrated between 0.05 and 0.075.
interpretation.uncertainty: Five sparse points and no repeats; the boundary between 0.05 and 0.075 is unresolved and a discrete regime change cannot be excluded.

interpretation.scope: controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0, frozen compliant shortened structure (near 0.16 m, far 0.11 m, section 0.95), sampled holding/terminal tip-speed weights
interpretation.statement: On the frozen compliant shortened structure at fixed terminal weight 0.05, holding-speed acceptance flips from pass at holding 0.05 (~0.0127 m/s) to fail at holding 0.06 (0.023994623331658485), while the same holding 0.09 passes at terminal 0.10 (0.010201160469407439), so a terminal×holding weight interaction plausibly governs acceptance rather than a fixed holding threshold.
interpretation.uncertainty: Only a small sampled set; no intermediate terminal weight between 0.05 and 0.10; solver-plan selection and structural sensitivity are not excluded.

interpretation.scope: Two sealed complete evaluations on the compliant structure (holding 0.09/terminal 0.05 and 0.09/terminal 0.075)
interpretation.statement: At fixed holding weight 0.09, the recorded holding_max_speed differs by 0.005878747594748938 between terminal weights 0.05 and 0.075, and both still fail speed, so the response is not a single monotone holding-weight boundary and weight interaction is at least consistent with the data.
interpretation.uncertainty: Two points cannot separate solver-plan selection from weight interaction or structural sensitivity; no repetition/variance is available, so no causal or boundary claim follows.
